EmailTemplate.name: School of Music Audition Date Change Request
EmailTemplate.subject: ASU School of Music Audition Date Change Request
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
We have received your request to change your audition date. Before we can process your request, please pay the $10 fee online: https://www.regonline.com/auditionFY16. After you submit the payment, please email MusicAdmissions@asu.edu for a new audition date confirmation email.
Sincerely,
{!Case.Thread_Id}
